head.t: One in three internationally educated nurses ‘never been promoted’ in UK
head.x: More than a third (34%) of internationally educated nurses and midwives have never been promoted, including one in five (21%) of those with at least 10 years’ experience in the UK, a survey has revealed.

head.t: Patient experience and engagement during acute non-invasive ventilation
head.x: Aim: To explore patients’ experiences of acute non-invasive ventilation (NIV) and examine the role of patient engagement in treatment acceptance and tolerance. Methods: A descriptive qualitative design was employed using semistructured interviews with five patients who had recently received acute NIV.
